# Original team code

`data.py` and `routing.py` are unmodified source from
`km-minsang/MetroRookies/05_시뮬레이션코드/김민상_강내면_온라인DRT_주차3분_코드.zip`.
The ZIP Git blob SHA is `e90577bfd686b4eab839e72d5e799b8856fc095e`.
They retain the original network normalization, service point projection,
directed link splitting, and shortest-time path tie-breaking.

No optimization or service event timestamps are changed by the replay converter.
